title: PopAlign: Population-Level Alignment for Fair Text-to-Image Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring a fairness discrepancy metric by classifying generated images using the DeepFace library for gender detection, alongside human evaluations assessing the diversity and fairness of image sets.

Measuring a fairness discrepancy metric by classifying generated images using the DeepFace library across racial categories (e.g., white, Asian, black, Latino Hispanic), alongside human evaluations assessing identity representation.
